description: An eight-bit shift register fed by a comparator, with a weighted sum of the bits as a CV output, for building random gate patterns and melodies

params.text: Sets the level the comparator input has to pass for a high bit to be clocked into the shift register, -5V to +5V
Sets how far the threshold voltage moves the comparator threshold, and in which direction, from -1 to +1
Enables the loop input, so that what is patched there is folded into the bit being clocked in
While on, that bit adds its weight to the random melody outputs; bit 1 is worth 1/255th of 8V and each higher bit twice as much as the one below it
Picks how the loop input and the comparator result are combined: XOR, AND or OR

inputs.text: Each rising edge here shifts every bit along by one and clocks the comparator result into the first bit
The signal the comparator measures; while it is above the threshold, a high bit is ready to be clocked in
Moves the comparator threshold, by the amount and direction set on the CV attenuverter
A gate here is combined with the comparator result before it reaches the shift register, using the operation chosen on LOOP LOGIC, and takes effect only while the loop is enabled
A gate above 2V here enables the loop input, overriding the LOOP ENABLE switch

outputs.text: 10V while the comparator input is above the threshold, and 0V while it is below
The weighted sum of the bits that are set and switched on, from 0V with none of them to 8V with all eight
The weighted sum of the bits that are set and switched on with its sign flipped, from 0V down to -8V
10V while that bit of the shift register is set, and 0V while it is clear

menu: Initialize Random Melody Only — puts the eight melody bit switches back to their default positions and leaves the rest of the module as it is
Randomize Random Melody Only — sets the eight melody bit switches at random and leaves the rest of the module as it is
Add CV expander — places a Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add output expander — places a Sequencer Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places a Sequencer Trigger Expander to the right of this module
Add random melody expander — places a Gated Comparator Random Melody expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Gated Comparator Gate Logic expander to the right of this module
